threadDescriptions.quayside-desks: Move and place the coworking desks at Quayside
threadDescriptions.quayside-network: Commission internet access at the new Quayside office
threadDescriptions.member-breakfast: Arrange the first member breakfast after relocation
threadDescriptions.flat-curtains: Replace the curtains in my apartment

items.text: Quayside move: twelve desks, six need their legs removed. Book the freight lift for Thursday morning.
items.rationale: Desk inventory and lift booking advance the office furniture move.

items.text: Network survey / Quayside. Fibre enters behind the kitchenette. Lena can test the line once the cabinet has power.
items.rationale: Describes the new office internet installation.

items.text: Window measurements at home: lounge 184 wide, bedroom 126. Keep the old curtain rods if the new rings fit.
items.rationale: Apartment curtain measurements are unrelated to the office relocation.

items.text: Lena says the breakfast coffee urn serves twenty. For the first Quayside member morning, borrow two and order oat milk.
items.rationale: Shared contact, but the action concerns catering the member breakfast.

items.text: Freight lift confirmation: Thursday 08:00–10:00, Quayside east entrance. Driver must bring felt pads.
items.rationale: Confirms the furniture delivery arrangement.

items.text: SSID proof from installer: Quayside Guest / Quayside Members. The member password is still unset; do not photograph the final label.
items.rationale: Wireless-network configuration at the destination.

items.text: Call Lena after lunch about the spare one.
items.rationale: The contact spans multiple tasks and the spare object is unspecified.

items.text: Breakfast RSVP count is 27 now. Make the name cards alphabetical, including the three members who are arriving before their teams move.
items.rationale: Attendance and place-card work concern the member breakfast.

items.text: Desk layout walk-through: leave a clear route from the lift, then build the back row first. Those two damaged tops stay in the old office until collection is arranged.
items.rationale: Documents move sequencing and desk placement.

items.text: Correction to Thursday's furniture booking: building maintenance has the lift until noon. Our desk delivery is now 13:00–15:00; the morning confirmation is superseded.
items.rationale: Explicitly revises the earlier freight-lift slot.

items.text: Bought the washed-linen curtain sample for the lounge. In daylight the grey is too blue; ask for the warmer natural shade.
items.rationale: Continues apartment curtain selection.

items.text: Quayside install handoff: keep the two desks nearest the cabinet unassembled until Lena finishes patching. Movers bring those tops at 14:00; network testing gets clear cabinet access from 13:00 to 14:00. The chalk line on the floor marks the space Lena needs to open the cabinet door fully, so do not stack the wrapped legs inside it while unloading. Build the desks by the windows during that first hour. If the line test overruns, leave the last two tops on their edge against the padded wall and call me before assembling them. After patching, Lena should photograph the cable route and check that no cable crosses a desk foot position. I will walk the furniture layout with the mover before the lift booking ends at 15:00.
items.rationale: Coordinates concrete furniture sequencing and network commissioning work.

items.text: Line test passed at the cabinet. Guest Wi-Fi drops near the south meeting room, so move the second access point outside its metal door.
items.rationale: Network test results and a coverage fix.

items.text: Need a longer cable. Maybe two metres.
items.rationale: No destination, equipment or purpose identifies a thread.

items.text: Member breakfast receipt: 32 pastries, fruit tray, two dairy-free spreads. Refund the duplicate fruit tray line before paying.
items.rationale: Catering invoice adjustment for the same breakfast.

items.text: Rename my list 'Quayside desks' to 'Quayside furniture move'; it now includes the stools too. Six loose desk legs are taped together by the lift.
items.rationale: Explicit list rename with further furniture move evidence.

items.text: Hem test on the apartment curtain sample: leave 12 mm above the floor. The laundry label allows a cool wash before measuring again.
items.rationale: Curtain fitting and fabric preparation at home.

items.text: Quayside member network now reaches the south room. Save the installer acceptance sheet with the line test, not in the breakfast receipts.
items.rationale: Network acceptance; passing mention of breakfast filing is not breakfast work.

items.text: All twelve desks are upstairs. One caster missing from a stool; photograph it for the mover before they close the furniture claim.
items.rationale: Completion and damage follow-up for the furniture move.

items.text: Breakfast debrief: 25 came, the early arrivals found us using the handwritten arrow. Save that sign for next month's member morning.
items.rationale: Records the outcome of the relocation breakfast.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: Lena appears on both jobs, but the urn and milk concern breakfast only.
